Kiso Valley, Gifu and Nagano Prefectures, Japan

### Road to Nagiso

| Walk, you suggest. So we skip the bus, buoyed by
| our dinner of charred fish. We wind
| upriver, a flow of moments rushing past
| last night’s minshuku window. We are
| two pins piercing a map,
| two needles lost in autumn topography, two 
| drops collecting in the valley between mountains.
| We carry the wind around our shoulders,
| our thoughts vacated to wonder.
| Leaves softly pause the seconds passing.
| Our lives, two points on two hemispheres, approach
| a bridge between them.
| Laughing, we test its suspension and 
| leap up.
